margins.source: the plan's own null (PLAN vs PLANr)

twin.role: FORM CONTROL: same statements, deranged attachment, token count held exactly

cell_kind: KNOWLEDGE -- one added store as one factor on the locked plan; the paired official read is the deliverable and the twin decides attribution
claim_boundary: Descriptive paired read on historically exposed TRAIN Fold A discovery rows, plus a cost measurement of the same flight and the per-node delta-consumption table. Development numbers only (owner decisions 28, 86). No superiority, generalisation, component-causal, bar or confirmatory claim; no cross-carrier claim; no geometry claim; no content claim that the derangement twin also reproduces.

decision_rule.rule: see protocol-registered-v1.json decision_rule (ADMITTED / NEUTRAL / HARMFUL / TWIN / PER_SCENARIO_HARM_BOUND / FRONTIER / DELTA_CONSUMPTION / REPLICATION)

delta_convention: delta = CELL-1 minus the sealed PLAN arm, in percentage points; negative is worse
diagnostics_required: DELTA SUPPLY REACH. Per node, the share of rows that received at least one delta and the share that received a FULL cap, beside the registered model-free upper bound (protocol supply_reach: at most 11 of 151 Solver values, 24 of 95 Reviewer values and 6 of 14 Planner values carry a facet id that any Perception candidate intent can equal). A node whose reach is zero on every row is an inert route and the verdict says so before any effect is discussed (the B9a-rec lesson).

E20 COMPACTION, per phase: rows compacted, at which phase and by how much, beside cell PLAN's own sealed ZERO. The registered worst-case bound puts the Solver phase at COMPACT_REQUIRED by 317 tokens, so a non-zero count is expected and is a caveat on the frontier row's token basis; an abstention caused by compaction is a failure.

ARM-VERSUS-TWIN SUPPLIED VOLUME. The derangement holds the store's total token count, not the SUPPLIED token count: the registered reach already differs per node (arm Solver 11 against twin Solver 22). The read reports the realised supplied items and supplied tokens per node for both arms and does not assume they match.

FINITE COMPLETIONS. The count of rows whose terminal_disposition.reason is "finite_completion", the affected sample ids, the delivered-draft versus abstention split, and -- only if the count is non-zero -- the primary official metric recomputed with those rows excluded BESIDE the registered all-rows number, which stays the number the decision rule reads. No row is ever filtered out of the scored manifest. Cell PLAN's own count on this roster is 10.
REACT EXHAUSTION. The count of rows whose disposition is react_exhaustion (cell PLAN's own count is 0), reported whether or not it is zero.

planner_action_illegal. The flight's own count, the sample ids that carry it, and their action character counts and SHA-256 values. Cell PLAN's own count on this roster is 1. Reported whether or not it is zero.

FIRST-REQUEST BYTE DELTA, stated honestly before contact: under this arm the Perception request is NOT byte-identical to the comparator's -- it carries the unconditional delta block. The structural stage reports which request keys moved and confirms that no key outside the armed set moved.
PER-SCENARIO intent and SLU tables over all 18 scenarios, in BOTH weightings, plus net harmed rows per scenario with any scenario of five or more flagged (owner decision 17).
ROW ACCOUNTING: 1,080 in, 1,080 out on both sides, no row dropped and no sample_id invented.

COST: actual generation contacts against cell PLAN's realised 4,424 and the 11,880 ceiling; actual repeated speech seconds; actual FIT endpoints; GPU hours read from the serving monitor over the lease window.

driver.arm_invocation: python scripts/analysis/plan_cell_read.py --stage <stage> --arm-run SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-DELTA-CELL-R01-V1 --arm-attempt attempt-slurp-native-stage3-delta-cell-r01-v1-generation --arm-fit-run SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-DELTA-CELL-R01-FIT-V1 --arm-label 'cell CELL-1 (the locked plan plus the per-node stage3-deltas store)' --comparator-run SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-LOCK-V1 --comparator-attempt attempt-slurp-native-default-plan-lock-train-fold-a-generation-v1 --comparator-label 'the sealed PLAN arm (the locked v2.0 plan)' --own-null-left-run SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-LOCK-V1 --own-null-left-attempt attempt-slurp-native-default-plan-lock-train-fold-a-generation-v1 --own-null-left-label 'cell PLAN' --own-null-right-run SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-LOCK-REPLICATE-V1 --own-null-right-attempt attempt-slurp-native-default-plan-lock-replicate-train-fold-a-generation-v1 --own-null-right-label 'cell PLANr' --lock-run SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-B5E-EXEMPLARS-K20-SLOT-STORE-V2-ANCHOR-TRAIN-FOLD-A-RECOVERY-V1 --lock-attempt <the sealed B5e attempt> --lock-label 'the B5e lock comparator' --package-dir docs/readiness/2026-09-22-slurp-stage3-delta-cell-r01-v1 --registered docs/readiness/2026-09-22-slurp-stage3-delta-cell-r01-v1/registered-facts-v1.json --h-slu 1.2485 --h-intent 0.9943 --analysis-root analysis/SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-DELTA-CELL-R01-PAIRED-ANALYSIS-V1
driver.lock_stage_note: the lock stage compares the arm to the B5e lock comparator with the delivery normaliser replayed, as every plan-based read has since cell PLAN. It is REPORTED, never a gate; the gate is the comparator clause.
driver.own_null_note: the comparator and the own-null LEFT side are the same sealed PLAN run. That is deliberate: the plan's own null is PLAN against PLANr, and PLAN is also this cell's gating comparator, so the stop stage reproduces the same sealed aggregate twice and the margin table once.
driver.twin_invocation: the same command with --arm-run SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-DELTA-CELL-TWIN-V1, --arm-attempt attempt-slurp-native-stage3-delta-cell-r01-v1-twin, --arm-fit-run SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-DELTA-CELL-TWIN-FIT-V1, --arm-label 'the CELL-1 derangement twin (form control)' and --analysis-root analysis/SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-DELTA-CELL-TWIN-PAIRED-ANALYSIS-V1. Same comparator, same margins, same estimator, same seed: the twin read is the arm read with one input changed.

efficiency_tables_required: HEADLINE EFFICIENCY: prefilled tokens per row, GPU hours per 1,080 rows, wall seconds per row, contacts per row, aggregate prefill tok/s and aggregate decode tok/s -- PLAN beside the anchor's own realized cost block and beside the B4b reference, with every number's source named (run manifest, flight receipts, monitor, or server.log).

PER-POSITION TABLE over the five positions perception / solver / reviewer 1 / reviewer 2 / planner: prompt tokens, prefilled tokens, cached share, generated tokens, speech-packet re-decode share and prefilled tokens per row -- PLAN beside the B4b reference of arms.efficiency_reference_not_an_arm, with the reference labelled as a reference on every row.
CONSTANCY: distinct_tool_schemas_sha256 per row (must be 1 on all 1,080), rendered_tool_names, and authority_tool_names per role -- from the sealed saea-native-tool-schema-rendering-v1 block.

PREFILL JOIN QUALITY: the share of contacts on which n_tokens - generated + 1 equals the client's usage.prompt_tokens. Below 100.00 % the per-role figures are reported as estimates, not measurements, and the verdict says so.
CLIENT PROMPT TOKENS per row and the per-contact delta at each of the three tool-free positions, stated as an EXPECTED RISE and explicitly not a regression.
SLOT OCCUPANCY AND UTILISATION over the lease window: mean busy slots, zero-busy share, parked fraction, mean utilisation, GPU power -- from flight receipts and monitor.jsonl.

estimators.not_used: analysis.score_compare_cli as the runner: it hard-codes ci_level 0.90 and DEV population names

metrics.counts: tp = [slu_f1_word_tp, slu_f1_char_tp], fp and fn likewise

output.harness_admission: on ADMITTED, and only after the replicate on the same roster, the coordinator writes the harness-admission entry in the form the protocol document's harness_admission_entry_form records; a NEUTRAL or HARMFUL verdict writes a results-ledger row and no admission entry
output.prints_only_aggregates: no utterance text, no gold, no delivered filler and no delta STATEMENT text is printed or persisted by the read: the delta-consumption table names value_ids, node targets, facet ids and counts only

resampling.clusters: 125 speaker clusters, 18 scenarios of 60 rows, 523 headset and 557 far-field rows, from the released roster metadata
resampling.interval_form: percentile pairs of the same retained replicate sequence
resampling.pairing_note: both sides of this contrast are decoded runs, so the paired interval carries real decoding noise; the own-null margins are the calibration for exactly that. A NON-INFERIORITY read is the correct shape here precisely because the expected true effect is zero.
resampling.sensitivity: paired scenario-stratified row bootstrap, same draws and seed

scorer.projection_v3_companion: slurp-slu-official-projected-v3-train, reported beside every official number (owner decision 7)
scorer.runs: once per complete manifest through core.scoring_batch, never sharded; this read invokes no scorer
scorer.symmetric_normalised_companion: slurp-slu-f1-normalized-v1-train, the TRAIN sibling registered under owner decision 14, reported beside every official number

tables_required: headline score: the sealed PLAN arm, CELL-1, the delta, speaker CI95, speaker CI90, the scenario-stratified CI90 and the equal-scenario delta, for official pooled SLU-F1 and intent
the SAME headline table for the twin arm, beside the arm's, with the twin delta and its CI95
per-scenario intent and SLU over all 18 scenarios, in both weightings, for the arm and for the twin
net harmed rows per scenario, with any scenario of five or more flagged (owner decision 17)
saves / harms / ties with the exact two-sided McNemar p
projection v3 and the TRAIN symmetric number beside every official number

THE PER-NODE DELTA-CONSUMPTION TABLE (item S3-4s): per node (perception / solver / reviewer / planner) and per scenario, the number of rows supplied, the mean and the distribution of items supplied per row against the node's cap, the distinct value_ids supplied with their supply counts, and -- joined to the paired per-row outcome -- the saves, harms and ties on the rows that received each value_id. Value ids, node targets, facet ids and counts only; never statement text.
the arm-versus-twin per-node SUPPLY COUNT identity: the two arms supply the same number of items per node per row (the token-matching evidence), with any row where they differ named
the mandatory diagnostics of the protocol document's diagnostics_required, in order
the frontier row: official SLU-F1 delta x prefilled tokens per row x GPU hours per 1,080 rows, pooled and per scenario (owner decision 75), for the arm and for the twin
